description:
OpenTelemetry SDK autoconfigure SPI interoperability layer. Discovers OTel SDK
        autoconfigure providers (ConfigurableSpanExporterProvider, ConfigurableMetricExporterProvider,
        ConfigurableSamplerProvider, ConfigurablePropagatorProvider, ResourceProvider,
        AutoConfigurationCustomizerProvider) via ServiceLoader on a caller-supplied ClassLoader
        and bridges them to the Humboldt SDK. The OTel SDK artifacts are provided-scope: the
        consumer supplies them at runtime (Humboldt itself never bundles the OTel SDK).
